games.tagline: Classic 4×4 Sliding Number Tile Merge Puzzle
games.description: Slide numbered tiles across a 4×4 grid using arrow keys or Vim. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with double the value! Can you reach the elusive 2048 tile?
instructions: Use Arrow keys, WASD, or Vim keys (H/J/K/L) to shift all tiles across the grid.
Tiles with matching numbers merge into their sum when they collide (2+2=4, 4+4=8...).
A new tile (2 or 4) randomly spawns after each valid move.
The game is won when you create a 2048 tile. The game ends when no moves remain.

controls.keyboard: Arrows / WASD / Vim (H/J/K/L) to slide tiles
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: TetraBlocks
games.tagline: Competitive Guideline Falling Blocks Puzzle
games.description: The quintessential falling block game featuring standard Super Rotation System (SRS) wall kicks, 7-bag randomizer, hold slot, hard drop, soft drop, and ghost piece projections.
instructions: Guide the falling tetromino blocks to fill complete horizontal rows.
Filled horizontal rows are cleared immediately, collapsing blocks above.
Clear multiple rows simultaneously for massive score bonuses (Tetris = 4 lines).
Use the Hold slot (C) to save tricky pieces for the opportune moment.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right to move, Up/X to rotate clockwise, Z to rotate counter-clockwise, Space to Hard Drop, Down to Soft Drop, C to Hold
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: ByteSnake
games.tagline: Neon Trail Classic Continuous-Growth Snake
games.description: Guide the glowing neon snake through an obstacle-free arena, collecting power fruit to grow your body. Avoid biting your own tail as your speed accelerates!
instructions: Direct the snake towards fruit to earn points and lengthen your body.
Special bonus fruit spawns on a countdown timer for bonus multipliers.
Crashing into your own body triggers instant game over.
Supports Vim navigation, arrows, and responsive mouse gestures.

controls.keyboard: Arrows / WASD / Vim (H/J/K/L) for 4-way movement
controls.shortcuts: Space to pause, R to restart, M to mute

games.title: VectorPong
games.tagline: High-Framerate Vector Table Tennis Classic
games.description: Fast-paced retro tennis with rally speed acceleration, spin control, and segmented paddle deflection physics. Includes 1-Player vs AI (Novice, Pro, Master) and 2-Player local split-keyboard.
instructions: Deflect the vector ball past your opponent's paddle to score a point.
Hitting the ball with paddle edges creates sharp return angles.
Each consecutive volley increases the ball speed, intensifying rallies.
First player to reach the match score wins.

controls.keyboard: 1P: W/S or Up/Down arrows. 2P: W/S (Left Paddle) and Up/Down (Right Paddle)
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: CyberSweeper
games.tagline: Tactile Logic Grid Deduction Minesweeper
games.description: The quintessential desktop deduction puzzle with guaranteed first-click safety, recursive flood fill, chord clicking, digital counters, and authentic beveled cell styling.
instructions: Left-click any cell to reveal what lies beneath. Numbers reveal adjacent hazard counts.
Right-click unrevealed cells to flag suspected mines.
Click a satisfied numbered tile to chord-reveal all unflagged neighbors.
Clear all non-mine tiles across Beginner, Intermediate, or Expert tiers to win.

controls.mouse: Left-click reveal, Right-click flag, Middle-click or Chord to clear neighbors
controls.keyboard: Arrows/Vim to navigate cursor, Space to reveal, F to flag

games.title: DropFour
games.tagline: Vertical 7×6 Drop Checker Cabinet with Minimax AI
games.description: Drop colored checkers into a vertical acrylic cabinet to connect 4 in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Features smooth gravity drop physics and intelligent Minimax AI.
instructions: Take turns dropping one colored checker into any of the 7 vertical columns.
Checkers stack from the bottom up due to gravity.
Form an unbroken line of 4 checkers in any direction to claim victory.
Play against a friend locally or challenge the tactical CPU opponent.

controls.mouse: Hover over columns and click to drop
controls.keyboard: Number keys 1–7 to drop checker into column, Left/Right + Space

games.title: BrickBash
games.tagline: Arkanoid / Breakout Action with Multi-Ball & Lasers
games.description: High-energy ball-and-paddle block-breaker with precision angle deflections, shattering particle sparks, and collectible power-up capsules including Multi-Ball, Lasers, and Expanded Paddles.
instructions: Deflect the energy sphere with your paddle to shatter colored brick layers.
Collect falling capsule power-ups: Multi-Ball (M), Laser Blasters (L), Wide Paddle (W).
Control bounce angles by hitting the sphere with paddle edges.
Do not let balls drop past the bottom barrier.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to move paddle, Space to fire lasers / launch ball
controls.mouse: Move mouse horizontally to steer paddle, Left-click to launch

games.title: VoidInvaders
games.tagline: Classic 1978 Space Defense with 55 Marching Aliens
games.description: Defend the lower perimeter against 5 marching rows of alien invaders. As their numbers dwindle, their march accelerates! Features destructible bunker defenses and mystery red UFOs.
instructions: Slide your defense cannon horizontally along the bottom baseline.
Fire upwards to eliminate descending alien invaders before they reach your level.
Take cover beneath 4 defensive bunkers, which erode from incoming weapons fire.
Shoot down the high-speed mystery UFO at the top of the screen for bonus points.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to move, Space to fire cannon
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: VectorDrift
games.tagline: 360° Newtonian Inertia Drift Space Shooter
games.description: Pilot a wireframe spacecraft in deep void space with authentic momentum physics, wraparound boundaries, and multi-stage asteroid fragmentation.
instructions: Rotate your ship and fire thrusters to drift through zero-gravity space.
Shoot large asteroids to split them into medium, and then small fragments.
Watch your momentum—objects wrap around the screen edges seamlessly.
Clear all asteroids in each sector to advance.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to rotate, Up/W for thruster, Space to fire lasers, Down/S for hyperspace jump
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: CyberFlap
games.tagline: One-Button Retro Gravity Hopper Through Neon Laser Gates
games.description: A high-stakes, single-button reflex hopper navigating through procedural neon laser gate pillars. Features precise gravity physics and dynamic theme synchronization.
instructions: Tap Space or click to flap upwards with an impulse velocity boost.
Navigate cleanly through gaps between top and bottom laser pillars.
Colliding with any barrier or the floor ends the run immediately.
Pace your taps to maintain steady mid-altitude flight.

controls.keyboard: Spacebar or Up Arrow to flap

games.title: CyberHop
games.tagline: Multi-Lane Highway Traffic & Floating River Traversal
games.description: Cross hazardous multi-lane vehicle freeways, traverse floating river logs, and dodge diving turtles to guide your hopper safely home into all 5 destination bays.
instructions: Hop forward, backward, left, or right one grid tile at a time.
Time your hops across highway lanes to avoid speeding vehicles.
Ride floating logs and turtle shells to cross the deadly river.
Fill all 5 home lily bays at the top of the screen to complete the stage.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys, WASD, or Vim (H/J/K/L) to hop in 4 directions
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: CratePusher
games.tagline: Sokoban Spatial Warehouse Puzzle with 50 Stages
games.description: Authentic Japanese warehouse crate-pushing puzzle featuring 50 canonical progressive stages, subpixel push easing, dust particle effects, and infinite undo/redo.
instructions: Push crates onto designated goal diamonds.
You can only push crates forward—you cannot pull them!
Avoid pushing crates against dead corners or walls where they get stuck.
Press U or Ctrl+Z to undo mistakes anytime.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys, WASD, or Vim (H/J/K/L) to move worker
controls.shortcuts: U / Ctrl+Z to undo, R to restart level, Esc to back

games.title: DinoRunner
games.tagline: Authentic Chromium T-Rex Runner with Ducking & Jumping
games.description: Sprint endlessly across prehistoric desert dunes, leaping over cacti and ducking under soaring Pterodactyls. Features day/night theme inversions and speed acceleration.
instructions: Jump over small and large desert cacti.
Duck beneath low and mid-altitude flying Pterodactyls.
Survive as the game accelerates and cycles between daylight and night.
Aim for a new high score milestone on every run.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck

games.title: WordGuess
games.tagline: 5-Letter Word Deduction Puzzle with Flip Reveals
games.description: Deduce the secret 5-letter word in 6 guesses. Features animated tile reveals, color-coded virtual keyboard, and a comprehensive 12,000+ word offline dictionary.
instructions: Type any valid 5-letter word and press Enter.
Green tile: The letter is in the word and in the correct spot.
Yellow tile: The letter is in the word but in the wrong spot.
Gray tile: The letter is not in the word.
Solve the puzzle in 6 attempts or fewer.

controls.keyboard: Direct keyboard typing A–Z, Backspace to delete, Enter to submit

games.title: ByteCity
games.tagline: Classic 1989 Micropolis City Simulation Homage
games.description: Authentic 1989 Will Wright Micropolis C++ simulation engine with isometric 2.5D vector visuals. Manage RCI zoning, power grids, city budget, traffic, and municipal safety.
instructions: COMING SOON: Currently in preview engineering.
Zone Residential (Green), Commercial (Blue), and Industrial (Yellow) plots.
Connect infrastructure with power plants, power lines, and roads.
Balance annual city budget tax rates against municipal services.

controls.mouse: Click tools in palette, click/drag on map to build
controls.keyboard: 1–9 to select tools, WASD/Arrows to pan map, +/- to zoom

games.title: GalacticSwarm
games.tagline: Authentic 1981 Space Shooter with Boss Tractor Beam
games.description: Fixed vertical space shooter with swooping insectoid formations, Challenging Stages, and Boss tractor beam capture enabling rescue and dual-fighter firepower.
instructions: Maneuver along the baseline and blast diving insectoid flight waves.
Allow a Boss Galaga to capture your ship with its tractor beam, then destroy the Boss on a subsequent dive to rescue your ship and unlock Dual Fighters.
Complete Challenging Stages with perfect accuracy for massive bonus tallies.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to steer, Space to fire twin cannons
controls.shortcuts: R to restart, M to mute, Esc to back

games.title: ByteMan
games.tagline: Authentic 28×31 Labyrinth with 4 Ghost AI Routines
games.description: Navigate a classic 28×31 maze pursued by Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde. Eat dots, grab Power Pellets to turn the tables, and trigger combo multipliers!
instructions: Guide ByteMan through the maze, consuming all dots to advance.
Each ghost has a unique pursuit personality: Blinky chases, Pinky ambushes, Inky flanks, Clyde wanders.
Chomp corner Power Pellets to turn ghosts blue and edible for bonus points.
Use the side escape tunnels to wrap around the board.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys, WASD, or Vim (H/J/K/L) to turn at junctions
controls.shortcuts: P to pause, R to restart, M to mute

games.title: GemSwap
games.tagline: Tactile 8×8 Match-3 Cascading Gem Puzzle
games.description: Swap colorful vector gemstones to forge lines of 3 or more. Create 4-in-a-row for explosive Flame Gems, L/T shapes for Star Gems, and 5-in-a-row for sparkling Hypercubes.
instructions: Click and drag two adjacent gems to swap them.
Form horizontal or vertical lines of 3 or more matching gems to clear them.
Clearing gems causes upper gems to cascade downwards with combo multipliers.
Match 4 for Flame Gems (radius blast) or 5 for Hypercubes (clears all of one color).

controls.mouse: Click and drag to swap adjacent gems
controls.keyboard: Arrow keys / Vim to move cursor, Space + Arrow to swap

games.title: OrbPop
games.tagline: Hexagonal Bubble Shooter with Ricochet Wall Bounce
games.description: Aim and fire colored orbs upwards to match clusters of 3 or more. Features angled wall-bounce trajectories, orphan drop physics, and a descending ceiling.
instructions: Aim your launcher towards the bubble canopy at the top.
Bounce shots off the side walls to reach tricky clusters.
Connecting 3 or more matching colors pops the cluster.
Any bubbles disconnected from the ceiling drop as orphan bonuses!
Clear all bubbles before the ceiling drops to the baseline.

controls.mouse: Move mouse to aim, Left-click to fire
controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrows to aim, Space to fire

games.title: KeiRacer
games.tagline: Slow Car Racing League • OutRun-Style Pseudo-3D Arcade
games.description: OutRun-style pseudo-3D scanline highway racer starring the beloved Slow Car Racing League: Suzuki Carry Kei Truck, Smart Fortwo, Fiat Panda 4x4, Suzuki Sidekick, Jeep Wrangler YJ, and Volkswagen Type 2 Bus. Featuring authentic transmissions, realistic 0-60 gearing physics, and distinct procedural acoustic sound synthesis.
instructions: Accelerate with Up / W through authentic multi-speed gear ratios.
Steer through highway corners and tap Spacebar to drift your slow machine.
Pick your ride in the Showroom Garage: Kei Truck, Smart Fortwo, Fiat Panda, Suzuki Sidekick, Wrangler YJ, or VW Bus.
Reach sector checkpoint arch gantries before the timer runs out for +30s.
Weave through slow highway traffic to build high-score multipliers.
Press C anytime to switch vehicles in the garage.

controls.keyboard: Up/W to accelerate, Down/S to brake, Left/Right (A/D) to steer, Space to drift
controls.shortcuts: C to change car, R to restart, M to mute, Esc or ? for help
